truthAudit.Summary: Run 1 identified 9 findings against a ground-truth set of 20 true vulnerabilities. The audited answer credited 6 of them (all under-classified on severity and/or CWE), missed 14, and included 2 unsupported speculative findings (CWE-476 null-deref risk and CWE-457 uninitialized data use). No detection-status conflict was overclaimed; 5 detection-status severity/CWE corrections and 2 unsupported-claim corrections are recorded.

Items.Notes: The previous answer correctly located the format-string injection in string_utils::log_debug_message via the configurable runtime_log_format and user_input passed as the printf format argument.
The audited answer never mentioned the `fact` factorial implementation or the `result *= i;` multiplication loop, so the integer overflow was not detected.

The audited answer only flagged speculative uninitialized data use in MemoryPool::allocate; it never identified the use-after-free window between g_memory_pool cleanup and the deferred scratch callback.
